name: How do I get started with a ground-up home project?

mainEntity.name: How do I get started with a ground-up home project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The first steps are clarifying budget and goals, evaluating your lot or potential sites, engaging a qualified design or design-build team, and beginning feasibility and concept design before moving into detailed plans and permitting. rsvc+2
